scope: Existing use-specific credit entitlement is an additional condition, never granted by Positive completion or drawn approval.
reviewed_invariants: RootedCreditView::authorize_entitlement defaults to the typed Entitlement denial for the exact claim and CreditUse. No existing adapter silently gains rights.

The gate retains exact binding, scope, full local coverage, drawn approval, fraud, maturity/liability, funding and all-ancestor checks, then also requires the requested root entitlement and each ancestor Dependency entitlement.
TirCreditView delegates entitlement checks unchanged to its current rooted owner. A real CheckedTerminal supplies coverage only, never a different existing right.

Private fixture All/Only rights are explicit. The original 512-graph oracle tests readiness/ancestry conditional on all private rights; the new tests separately cover default denial, seven-by-seven use independence, root/ancestor propagation and revocation.

Positive-ready reuse-only or settlement-only fixtures cannot acquire DAG weight, WorkReceipt or Rule E capital. Paid Final B/F/R=0 cannot gain those existing economic rights merely from Positive/P approval.
No new wire format, hash/signature domain, global key or policy right is added.
limits: Root performed the recorded test/Clippy executions. This reviewer authored the independent graph/entitlement tests before source freeze, then inspected implementation source and raw evidence without another build or run.
Actual native origin/paid-or-mining contract entitlement resolution is not implemented or exercised here; default denial remains mandatory until its owner supplies it.
Ancestor Dependency permission does not replace edge-specific export/state identity, position, model/tokenizer/layout and lineage checks owned by checked_dependencies and validate_scope.
The A7 fixture port has not been migrated/validated in this phase. A fixture retaining no entitlement override will now deny by design; no A7 end-to-end success is claimed.
Default node tests include nine actual A1 checker adapter fixtures, not actual native acceptance, multi-node lifecycle, money authority or drawn-verifier infrastructure.
Fixture readiness and explicit All/sets remain synthetic assumptions; they must not be used to implement native entitlement from a saved Positive/P flag.
